reader.requirement: At --std 85 a REWRITE of a relative file, in every access mode (sequential, random, dynamic) and whether it succeeds or fails (43, invalid key 23), leaves the file position indicator where the previous READ/START put it, so the next sequential READ / READ NEXT returns the record after the one last read.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses the 2002 FILE phrase and the word RECORD after record-name at 85 (syntax only, not the FPI)

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|IsActive|DialectBehavior over RelativeConnector.Rewrite, FileRegistry REWRITE dispatch, FileConnector.MutationOpenModeGuard/RecordProcessed: none; Rewrite never writes _fpi/FpiValid/_inclusive. The only edition switch in RelativeConnector is the WRITE key-range arm.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness exercises the position after a sequential REWRITE; not exercised: dynamic access REWRITE of a different key than the last read, a failed REWRITE (43, invalid key 23), random READ then REWRITE then READ NEXT

probes.printed: SEQ-READ2=00 REC2---- SEQ-REWR=00 SEQ-NEXT=00 REC3---- | DYN-NEXT=00 (rec 2) DYN-REWR5=00 DYN-NEXT2=00 REC3---- RK=0003 | RW9 INV DYN-REWR9=23 DYN-NEXT3=00 REC4---- | DYN-REWR1=00 DYN-NEXT4=00 rec 2 | DYN-NEXT6=00 DYN5REWR | EOF6 DYN-NEXT7=10
probes.expected: §1985:VIII.4.6.4 GR7: each READ NEXT continues from the record last read, unaffected by the REWRITE (whatever key it rewrote)
a failed REWRITE (43) leaves the position too; the next READ gives record 4

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.6.4 GR7  (cite.py --check "The file position indicator is not affected by the execution of a REWRITE statement")

reader.notes: Rewrite reads _lastSlot or the pending relative key, replaces the slot and returns; no FPI field is touched on any path. Probes in sequential and dynamic access, with success, 23 and 43 outcomes, all continue from the last record read.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-04/c2/r2.cob at --std 85, a RECORD VARYING 2 TO 8 DEPENDING ON relative file in dynamic access, positions the reader did not try: REWRITE of record 1 straight after OPEN I-O (FPI=1, nothing read) then READ NEXT gives NEW1 RK=0001 (the first record, not the second); START KEY NOT LESS THAN 3, REWRITE of key 5, READ NEXT gives REC0003 (the START position survives); a REWRITE that fails 44 (length 9 > 8) leaves the position (next READ NEXT = REC0004); a random READ of 6 then REWRITE of key 2 then READ NEXT gives AT END 10 (the position stays on 6, not on 2). No REWRITE path moves the position. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.6.4 GR7 ('The file position indicator is not affected by the execution of a REWRITE statement'). Side observation (label only, not this rule): COBOL2796 at --std 85 cites §2023:14.5.1.
